chunks: They ask: 'When is the Day of Judgement?'
ai.seo_question: What do the disbelievers ask about in Surah Al-Dhariyat regarding the Day of Judgement?
ai.summary: In Surah Al-Dhariyat, this verse captures the impatient skepticism of the Meccan disbelievers who demanded an immediate timeline for the Day of Reckoning. From a Shia scholarly perspective, this inquiry underscores the divine wisdom in keeping the Hour unknown, serving as a test of faith and a reminder of Allah's absolute authority over time. The verse ultimately redirects their focus from speculative timing to the inevitable reality of divine accountability.
